summaries.summary: HPXPrinterDetails is an Android mobile automation page class extending SmartFlow for HP printer app testing. It implements comprehensive printer interaction patterns including: (1) Swipe-to-find navigation with configurable retry logic for tile-based UI elements, (2) Verification methods for UI element presence validation, (3) Data extraction methods for product information retrieval, (4) Direct click actions for button interactions, (5) Conditional interaction patterns for optional UI elements, (6) Hybrid fallback approach using coordinate-based gestures when element location fails, (7) Status verification for print job monitoring. The class uses driver.wait_for_object(), driver.click(), driver.swipe(), and driver.get_text() as primary interaction methods. Notable patterns include max_swipes parameters (ranging 3-5) for scrollable content, timeout configurations (10-20s), and raise_e flags for exception handling control. Supports workflows for scanning, printing, copying, faxing, shortcuts, product information access, and printer configuration. Implements mobile gesture fallback (execute_script with mobile:clickGesture) for unreliable element locations.
